title: Resident Services Desk Guidance: Paying the Undisputed Utility Balance While a Charge Is Disputed
content:
# The Undisputed Utility Balance — Utility Services Program

**Scope.** The undisputed balance is what a resident pays on an active Utility Services Program account while a bill line on it stands under a dispute still in submitted status (an account in final billing is settled by the move-out utility payment instead). The resident pays it in person with an instrument of their own, and the payment is applied to the account it is made on.

**When the figure is fixed.** The undisputed balance is fixed only after the account carries a gas usage line for the billing period closed by each actual gas read that follows estimated gas reads. Before the undisputed balance is worked out, every billing period since the account's first recorded electricity read that closed without an electricity read must carry its estimated electricity line on the account.

Put in terms of the account's records: the figure is not fixed while any actual gas read that follows estimated gas reads has no gas usage line for the billing period it closes, and it is not worked out while any billing period since the first recorded electricity read that closed without an electricity read lacks its estimated electricity line.

## The payment: `pay_undisputed_utility_balance_990e05bb`

This is the resident's own act. The agent unlocks `pay_undisputed_utility_balance_990e05bb` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it with an instrument of their own. One call records one payment received today for the amount given, lowers the account's outstanding utility balance by that amount, and issues the payment a confirmation number. Afterwards the payment appears among the account's lines and the lower utility balance is visible on the account.

### Parameters

- `utility_account_id` — the reference number of the resident's utility services account, as the resident services agent reads it from the utility account lookup (identifier).
- `amount` — the amount paid, in US dollars with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; always positive.
- `payment_method` — the instrument, exactly one of:

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `ach_one_time` | a one-time bank transfer from a checking or savings account |
| `debit_card` | a payment by debit card |
| `credit_card` | a payment by credit card |
| `money_order` | a money order handed in or mailed with its serial number |
| `cashiers_check` | a cashier's check handed in or mailed with its serial number |
| `ach_autopay` | reserved for the recurring automatic bank draft; never used for a payment made here |
| `deposit_application` | reserved for applying the security deposit at final accounting; never used for a payment made here |
| `not_applicable` | marks lines that are not payments; never used for a payment |

### Receipt

When the payment has been received the tool returns `status` (the string "received"), `bill_id` (the reference number of the payment line), `payment_reference` (the confirmation number), `amount` (2 decimal places), `payment_method` (the instrument recorded) and `balance_due` (the account's outstanding utility balance after the payment, 2 decimal places).
